lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso; spacing is widest between stripes 1-3 and most compressed at the posterior junction.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcations observed at the dorsal terminus of the 4th and 8th stripes (counting from anterior to posterior), where lines split into Y-shapes.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripe 1 and stripes 11-13 appear as abbreviated segments that do not extend to the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 6 distinct circular white spots located on the lower haunch, positioned below the terminal vertical stripes.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spots on the mid-thigh area creates a semi-connected linear geometric marker.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white chevron on the nasal bridge and a distinct white horizontal patch on the lower throat.
